Common techniques include impersonating trusted organizations, creating urgency and linking to fraudulent login pages. Spear phishing targets a specific individual or organization using tailored details. Analysts examine sender identity, message headers, links and attachment metadata. A suspicious message should be reported through approved channels rather than forwarded broadly. Multifactor authentication, email filtering and user training can reduce risk. Defenders can use domain registration information and authentication results as supporting context.
